text: Hey how's the launch campaign going? 🙂
Honestly mixed. Client changed the headline again. Third version since monday
[photo: three headlines on a whiteboard, one crossed out]
Which one is winning
None yet. They want the first one but with "smarter" in it lol
Smarter is doing a lot of work there
Right?? Anyway are you done with the posters
Almost. Printer in nehru place is being slow with the proofs. Probably tomorrow
Client wants the blue darker and I told them the blue is fine
Lol
Good for you 🙃
Did you eat? I'm having chole bhature at my desk (not proud)
Not yet. Ordered dal. Can barely see the metro out there, it's thick fog
Going to bed. Don't stay up on the proofs
No promises
Fog still here. Can't see the building across the road
Did you sleep at least
I'm in a meeting at 10 that's going to run over
Slept ok. Went to nehru place at 10, proof's ready. Sending a pic
[photo: printed poster proof on a table, blue background, large type]
The blue is fine 🙂
It is fine. Honestly the blue is the best thing on it
Client sent headline #4 at lunch. It's "smarter, faster, yours"
I'm not crying, you're crying
Lol. Is that the one
They've approved it. The whiteboard is now officially a crime scene
Can you send the banner dimensions? Need them for the file before I leave
1200x628 for the feed one, 1080x1920 for stories. Full brief tonight
Ok thanks
Brief's in your inbox. Sorry it's late, client keeps adding things
Got it. Haven't opened it yet, just got home. Dal from yesterday still in the fridge, not doing that again
Did you eat or is it desk food again
Desk food. Samosa and chai from the stall downstairs. Not proud again
Was the printer thing sorted
Yes. Printer guy kept apologising like it was personal. Final file goes to client tomorrow morning
The fog is somehow worse at night 😑
Good. You can stop looking at it now
Final file's with the client. Sent at 8
Fog still on. The bus stop across the road is just a shape
Good. Client's now asking if the posters can say "smarter" in the bottom corner too
I said I'd check
Please don't
Opened the brief. Banners are doable. Stories file is going to be annoying with the logo at the top
Sorry. Told you it's late
Lunch?
Eating now. Paratha from the corner, not dal 🙃
Fog lifted a bit
Did the client ever reply on the posters
Not yet. Probably means they're deciding what to change
Feed banner draft is up if you want to look. Logo's fine at the top with a bit of padding
[photo: feed banner draft, blue background, headline in white, small logo top left]
That's nice. Headline's a bit big for the mobile crop maybe
Otherwise it's the best thing I've seen all week. Low bar
Thanks. Will shrink it
Leaving soon. Metro's packed on a Thursday for no reason
Get home safe. Did the samosa stall stay open?
They close at 8 now, it's a whole thing
Shrunk the headline. Sent the feed one to you. Going to sleep, stories tomorrow
Looks good. Sleep
